cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll organize our election support. Will you wear my ribbon or Nina's at the chess club?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep both friendships. Choose whichever color sits well with your jacket today; I just need to know who you want chairing us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's the vote. Tell me who gets your ribbon then, and I'll arrange today however keeps everyone comfortable. I can lend you Nina's now if you're choosing me for the chair.

heightening.evidence: A5 can help display the rival today if it secures A support when chair authority is decided.
